items.title: Being smooth is fpqc local on the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that smoothness is fpqc local on the base (statement lines 6386-6390). The proof follows the syntomic pattern: it displays that a morphism is smooth if and only if it is locally of finite presentation, flat, and has smooth fibres, recalls fpqc locality of flatness and of local finite presentation, and concludes with the lemma asserting fpqc locality of the set of points where the fibres are smooth (proof lines 6392-6400). The level is H2: the decomposition is written out and each of the three ingredients is identified with its input.
